marcos (PM): Quick decision: need final MVP cutline for Milestone 9 by EOD. Suggest keep: embeddings cache, basic SSO, autoscale. Defer: per-tenant dashboards, advanced quant tuning, admin analytics. Thoughts?
anja (eng): +1. Dashboards are ETL+UI heavy. Keeping cache + autoscale preserves latency SLOs.
lee (eng-ml): embeddings cache is mandatory for p95. Also request a small guard: if duplicate-token rate > 2x, auto-disable cache on canary. I can PR today.
tori (design): If dashboards are deferred, I'll ship a lightweight placeholder with a pilot CTA and CSV export UX so CS can demo.
drew (sales): BetaCorp and Orion asked for dashboards. They'll accept pilot access if we provide migration support. I'll try to lock two pilots.
ops-bot: Reminder: release window 4187700000. Update release checklist if feature flags or export endpoints are added.
marcos (PM): OK: cutlist agreed. Action items: Anja -> story points + migration notes by 11am; Lee -> eval PR with cache guard today; Tori -> placeholder + CSV mock by EOD; Drew -> pilot outreach. I'll update milestone board and notify execs. Thanks :thumbsup:
